description: REFERENCE (rom_signature + segments) for Advance Wars GBA (USA AWRE). The gba_advance_wars.py plugin is a stub (returns no segments), so the documented addresses come from MANUAL ROM ANALYSIS (verified on the USA ROM, not from a Python plugin): fixed ASCII mission-name area 0x80D44-0x8162C (0x00-terminated ASCII). Covered: that single fixed ASCII region only. The game's dialog uses a custom encoded charset (not plain ASCII) - character table not implemented yet, use a future Python plugin for complete coverage. Advance Wars 2 (AWRP/AWRJ) uses different addresses. Hack authors: copy and adapt title_pattern to match YOUR hack ROM title.
